metadata.question: In the summer of 2021, did at least 6 million hectares of forests burn in Sakha?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Focus on a collection able to detect burned area. - The official “MCD64A1 Burned Area Monthly” collection (MODIS 500 m) is too coarse, has annual units (not per-month) and tends to miss small fires. - Instead use the MODIS (MCD64A1) version 6 **monthly** 500 m burned-area flag (ba_product) available in GEE: `"MODIS/006/MCD64A1"`. - The band `"BurnDate"` contains the ordinal day of burn since 2000-01-01; however we only need a “burned / not-burned” mask. - Pixel-wise, the valid value range is 1–366 in leap years, so any value ≥1 in the June–August 2021 composite is flagged as “burned”. 2. Geometry & time: - “Sakha” is the Republic of Sakha (Yakutia). Its FIPS 295 polygon is in `USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017` (feature id = "RU-SA"). - “Summer” here is June–August 2021. Monthly composites, then sum area. 3. Masking: - No cloud masking – burned-area product is a classification. - Need to mask the “unburned” background (flag = 0) and areas outside land. 4. Workflow & sanity checks (per instruction): - Right after filtering the collection, check `.size().getInfo()`. If 0 ⇒ C1. - After creating a spatial composite, count valid pixels inside ROI with `ee.Reducer.count()`. If 0 valid pixels (all outside, or no fires) ⇒ C2. - Compute total burned area (m²) then convert to hectares (1 ha = 10000 m²). - Validate no NaN/None: the sum must be a finite positive number. If None/NaN/∞ ⇒ C3. - Finally, answer A (≥6 Mha) or B (<6 Mha). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1) Geometry: Sakha Republic (Yakutia) from LSIB simple (id RU-SA) sakha = ee.FeatureCollection("USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017") \ .filterMetadata("country_na", "equals", "Russia") \ .filter(ee.Filter.eq("iso_3166", "RU-SA")).first().geometry() # 2) MODIS version-6 monthly 500 m burned-area product col = (ee.ImageCollection("MODIS/006/MCD64A1") .select("BurnDate") .filterDate("2021-06-01", "2021-08-31") .filterBounds(sakha)) n = col.size().getInfo() print(f"2021 Jun-Aug Images: {n}") if n == 0: print("C1") import sys; sys.exit(0) # 3) Composite & burn mask (pixel=1 if any burn in study period) burned = col.max().gt(0) # gt(0) keeps pixels with valid burning (1-366) pixel_area = burned.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()) # m2 per pixel # 4) Valid-pixel count (C2 check) pix_cnt = (pixel_area .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=sakha, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9) .get("constant").getInfo()) print(f"Valid burn pixels: {int(pix_cnt)}") if pix_cnt == 0: print("C2") import sys; sys.exit(0) # 5) Burned area calculation tot_m2 = (pixel_area .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=sakha, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9) .get("constant").getInfo()) if tot_m2 is None or tot_m2 != tot_m2: # None or NaN print("C3") import sys; sys.exit(0) tot_ha = tot_m2 / 10000.0 print(f"Total burned: {tot_ha/1e6:.2f} million ha") print("A" if tot_ha >= 6e6 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1) Geometry: Sakha Republic (Yakutia) from LSIB simple (id RU-SA)
sakha = ee.FeatureCollection("USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017") \
          .filterMetadata("country_na", "equals", "Russia") \
          .filter(ee.Filter.eq("iso_3166", "RU-SA")).first().geometry()

# 2) MODIS version-6 monthly 500 m burned-area product
col = (ee.ImageCollection("MODIS/006/MCD64A1")
       .select("BurnDate")
       .filterDate("2021-06-01", "2021-08-31")
       .filterBounds(sakha))

n = col.size().getInfo()
print(f"2021 Jun-Aug Images: {n}")
if n == 0:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    import sys; sys.exit(0)

# 3) Composite & burn mask (pixel=1 if any burn in study period)
burned = col.max().gt(0)  # gt(0) keeps pixels with valid burning (1-366)
pixel_area = burned.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea())  # m2 per pixel

# 4) Valid-pixel count (C2 check)
pix_cnt = (pixel_area
           .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                         geometry=sakha,
                         scale=500,
                         maxPixels=1e9)
           .get("constant").getInfo())
print(f"Valid burn pixels: {int(pix_cnt)}")
if pix_cnt == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    import sys; sys.exit(0)

# 5) Burned area calculation
tot_m2 = (pixel_area
          .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
                        geometry=sakha,
                        scale=500,
                        maxPixels=1e9)
          .get("constant").getInfo())

if tot_m2 is None or tot_m2 != tot_m2:  # None or NaN
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    import sys; sys.exit(0)

tot_ha = tot_m2 / 10000.0
print(f"Total burned: {tot_ha/1e6:.2f} million ha")

print("<answer>A</answer>" if tot_ha >= 6e6 else "<answer>B</answer>")
